Read Get OTP enabled on the clickable outer View
Press digit keys without replacing the field
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Read first Amount · Online Mode line
Read Accept enabled on the clickable outer View
Check Request to extend time dialog
Tap first Quick Booking Accept (outer View)
Check Request to extend time dialog
Check Select an operator field is on Assign machine
Check Request to extend time dialog
Check Select an operator field is on Assign machine
Select first operator from Assign machine dropdown
